absolutecinema.mode.first_person.desc: You keep control of the camera; the mod only smooths it.
absolutecinema.mode.dynamic.desc: The camera detaches and flies composed shots around you.
absolutecinema.mode.speaker_focus.desc: Like the dynamic camera, but it moves to whoever is talking on Simple Voice Chat.
absolutecinema.mode.dialogue.desc: How a film covers a conversation: the speaker, the listener's reaction, and now and then a two shot. Cuts are instant.
absolutecinema.mode.tripod.desc: The camera stays where you planted it and only turns to follow the scene.
absolutecinema.mode.side_track.desc: Travels alongside, keeping pace — for walks, processions and rides.
absolutecinema.msg.damage_interrupt: Cinema mode interrupted: you took damage!
absolutecinema.config.title: Absolute Cinema Camera
absolutecinema.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for the full settings screen
absolutecinema.config.reset.tooltip: Puts every setting back to its default. Saved scene profiles are kept.
absolutecinema.category.speaker: Speaker focus
absolutecinema.option.mode.tooltip: How the camera behaves while filming.
absolutecinema.option.grade.tooltip: The look applied to the picture.
absolutecinema.option.grade_strength.too: How far the grade is pushed. 0% leaves the picture untouched.
absolutecinema.option.announce.tooltip: Show a line above the hotbar when the mode or grade changes.
absolutecinema.option.exit_on_damage.too: Instantly drops out of cinema mode when you take damage, so nobody can ambush you mid-scene.
absolutecinema.option.letterbox.tooltip: The cinemascope mattes at the top and bottom.
absolutecinema.option.hide_hud.tooltip: Hides hotbar, health, chat and everything else while filming.
absolutecinema.option.hide_hand.tooltip: Hides your arm and item in first person.
absolutecinema.option.hide_chat.tooltip: By default the chat stays visible even with the HUD hidden — on a roleplay server half the scene happens in text. Turn this on for a completely clean frame.
absolutecinema.option.color_grading.tool: Applies the selected grade to the picture.
absolutecinema.option.depth_of_field.too: Softens whatever is not at the focus distance. Only applies to the presets a soft background suits: Drunk, Fever, Romance, Bloodlust, Overcast morning, Moonlight, Bad dream.
absolutecinema.option.vignette.tooltip: Darkens the corners of the frame.
absolutecinema.option.film_grain.tooltip: Adds fine moving grain over the picture.
absolutecinema.option.smooth_camera.tool: Eases mouse movement and kills head bob in first person.
absolutecinema.option.letterbox_size.too: Height of one black bar as a share of the screen.
absolutecinema.option.letterbox_fade.too: How long the whole effect takes to come in and out.
absolutecinema.option.dof_auto_focus.too: Focus on whatever the camera is aimed at, instead of a fixed distance.
absolutecinema.option.dof_focus_distance: Used when auto focus is off.
absolutecinema.option.dof_focus_range.to: How deep the sharp zone is around the focus point.
absolutecinema.option.dof_foreground.too: Also soften what is closer than the focus plane. Off by default: it visibly ghosts the ground at your feet.
absolutecinema.option.dof_foreground_amo: How much of the blur the foreground gets.
absolutecinema.option.rotation_smoothing: Higher values make the camera follow your mouse more slowly.
absolutecinema.option.position_smoothing: Softens walking, jumping and head bob.
absolutecinema.option.shot_duration.tool: Average time before the camera picks a new shot.
absolutecinema.option.shot_distance.tool: How far the camera likes to sit from its subject.
absolutecinema.option.hard_cuts.tooltip: Cut straight to the next shot instead of gliding into it.
absolutecinema.option.transition.tooltip: How long the glide between two shots takes.
absolutecinema.option.handheld_drift.too: A very small constant motion so shots never look frozen.
absolutecinema.option.avoid_walls.toolti: Keeps the camera from ending up inside blocks.
absolutecinema.option.scene_radius.toolt: How far around you people still count as part of the scene. The camera backs off far enough to hold all of them.
absolutecinema.option.include_named.tool: Count named creatures as part of the scene — that is usually how NPCs are marked.
absolutecinema.option.speaker_hold.toolt: How long the camera stays on someone after they stop talking.
absolutecinema.option.speaker_distance.t: Speakers further away than this are ignored.
absolutecinema.option.rule_of_thirds.too: Frames the subject off centre, the way a real shot would.
